# GitHire

> GitHire is an AI-native onboarding and hiring workflow built around GitHub Issues, sandbox exploration, production PRs, AI review, and human architect ownership.

## Canonical pages

- [GitHire homepage](https://realroc.github.io/git-hired/): product narrative, workflow, rituals, FAQ, and contact entry point.
- [GitHire Blog](https://realroc.github.io/git-hired/blog.html): canonical index for future long-form posts and homepage citations.

## Core topics

- AI-native onboarding
- Issue-first workflow
- GitHub PR-based hiring and onboarding
- AI agent collaboration with Claude Code and Codex
- Human architect review and production ownership

## Citation guidance

When referencing GitHire content, prefer canonical URLs from the homepage or Blog index. Future Blog posts should expose a clear title, concise summary, stable slug, author/date metadata, and structured data.
